gaps.sentence: There were so ___ complaints that the scheme was dropped.
I'd rather walk than ___ the bus.
gaps.explanation: 'would rather do A than do B' — both bare infinitives.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.

gaps.sentence: He denied ___ the vase, though the camera saw him.
___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.

gaps.sentence: I'll have finished the report ___ Friday.
I've been waiting ___ half an hour.
He talks as if he ___ the owner of the place.
gaps.explanation: 'As if he were' — subjunctive for an unreal comparison.
